prompt: Clean base reference for Nemea Halolink. Attached drawing is identity and proportions reference only. Mature adult human female conductor, ordinary human anatomy, preserve depicted build. Fully covered plain seamless matte gray close-fitting unitard from neck to wrists and ankles, no loose cloth. Bald, no beard. Bare hands and feet. No costume, hair, jewelry, tools, vehicles, weapons, accessories. Front orthographic full body neutral wide symmetrical A-pose, straight arms angled 45 degrees down/out, separated fingers, clear armpit gaps, straight legs slightly apart. Entire head hands feet visible with 12% transparent margin. Neutral gray sculpt, readable joints, no floor, shadow, text or halo. One adult base only.
